steps.message: The tests passed. I have fixed the issue where `wait=False` was ignored when launching URLs with `xdg-open` (and also `open` on macOS) in `typer.launch`.
I have successfully implemented the fix and verified it with a script.

The `typer.launch` function was ignoring the `wait` parameter when launching URLs starting with `http://` or `https://` on macOS and Linux/BSD, always calling `.wait()` on the launched process. I updated `typer/main.py` to respect the `wait` parameter for both `open` (macOS) and `xdg-open` (Linux/BSD).
